---
title: MIR 1.1.0 direct F200/F210 successor fixture
---

This private fixture consumes only the protected published MIR 1.1.0 F200 source save made by `f200-110-source`. Its source directory is new, but each wrapper deliberately retains the source fixture mod name and storage key: Factorio scopes saved `storage` to that mod identity, so a differently named observer could not read the protected source state. It has distinct F200 and direct F210 Base package versions; it does not use an intervening MIR5 F200 save, a Space Age repair route, or a current roster assertion.

Before candidate work, it validates the complete saved 31-row source roster, exact published 75-effect multiset snapshots, earned source recipe bonuses, the worker-robot-battery force contribution, all 42 original startup values, native zero manual-mining fields, foreign queued `.42`, and detached `.27` state. Current-only MIR5 additions remain unearned and outside the historical source roster. The current public module row is independently required to retain its normal nine effects; the three historical tier-one `.01` effects must instead be present as separate hidden earned holders at the saved completed level.

After that read-only preflight, it accelerates and observes exactly one real candidate gear laboratory completion, checks the resulting level and gear bonus, saves once, and requires two cold reloads. It consumes only the protected r05 source save; its candidate package is bound separately after a coherent source/player/archive freeze. This fixture is preparation only, not native migration acceptance or a current package result.

The [enabled-field correction](../../../../spec/evidence/migration-origin-110-enabled-preflight-correction-r01.json) preserves the original current005D startup refusal0609. Its data-stage guard now interprets an absent `enabled` as the documented native defaulttrue while retaining literaltrue; the disabled arm still requiresfalse, and malformed/opposite values stop before acceleration. This validates the effective setting rather than one raw spelling. It makes no force-state or migration-pass claim: rebuild/pin the corrected fixture and retry the unchanged protected88FC source, then check actual lab/effects/save/two-reload behavior.

The completed-successor configuration handler distinguishes a first upgrade from a subsequent configuration event on an already completed save. A first upgrade retains its original source preflight and one actual candidate lab. A completed successor instead reruns the entire original completion contract, including all31 rows, three forces, hidden earned module holders, startup values, native recipe/robot/mining contributions, foreign queue and detached saved progress, and exactly one prior candidate laboratory completion. It also validates the recorded direct delta against the exact current native effect. The completed branch creates no lab, queues no research, resets no effects, saves nothing and changes no durable state. Incomplete, malformed, unknown or changed successor state still fails. This is preparation for adding a bounded read-only Library observer to the existing protected029AA/8DCF successors; it is not permission to skip configuration checks or claim a current-package native continuation before execution. The original sourceGear2-versus-completedGear3 host refusal is retained with its exact source/hash in the correction record.
